description: Focus: which network this Mac is on (to show work mail on work networks), and Thunderbird's own new-mail alerts (off while Ember decides which new mail to announce).

functions.name: network
functions.description: The network this Mac is on: key (a hash of its router's hardware and IP address, the same each time; null when offline or unknown), router (its IP address), dns (the network's DNS suffixes, a hint for naming it), linkUp.

functions.name: setMailAlerts
functions.description: Thunderbird's new-mail alert and sound: false turns them off (remembering how they were), true puts them back as they were.

events.name: onNetworkChanged
events.description: The network may have changed (connected, disconnected, another network). Ask network() again.
